subject: Partner syndication engineering handoff + SKU billing mapping
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan@cloudbridge.io>

Cc: cloudbridge-marketplace-team@cloudbridge.io
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudBridge -> Redwood: marketplace syndication kickoff

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. CloudBridge is ready to move forward with the co-sell listing and syndication work for ACME Health. To make the engineering handoff smooth, can you: 

- Share the minimal evidence list you need for the listing (metering, entitlement, billing SKU matrix).
- Confirm the preferred data ingest pattern for trial usage (SaaS token vs. reseller egress).
- Point us to your staging/test endpoint we can hit for entitlement checks.

I've attached our internal intake so your team can see our current mapping. We can loop in Matt from ACME for compliance questions if helpful.

Cheers,
Susan
Partner Ops, CloudBridge
--
Attachment: cb_intake_initial.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Susan Park <susan@cloudbridge.io>, Matt Cho <matt.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudBridge -> Redwood: marketplace syndication kickoff

Susan, Matt — thanks. Quick answers below and a pro forma checklist attached.

Summary answers:
- Evidence: billing proof (SKU IDs), metering contract excerpt, API entitlement call example, sample telemetry headers.
- Trial ingest: for co-sell we recommend the reseller egress pattern (CloudBridge forwards trial tokens to Redwood) — this keeps billing attribution clean.
- Staging endpoints: https://staging-api.redwood.example/entitlement-check (see doc link).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Ben to own the SKU mapping with CloudBridge (Ben, can you review their intake and produce a draft mapping).
2) Karthik to validate the entitlement API shape against our staging endpoint.
3) Susan to collect legal meter excerpt and confirm ACME requirements.

Attachments: syndication-checklist-v1.xlsx (checklist), sku-mapping-template.csv (blank template)

Thanks — I’ll set a 30-min sync for Mon to walk the mapping.

—
Soojin Lee
Head of Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudBridge -> Redwood: marketplace syndication kickoff

Susan / Soojin — attached is my first-pass SKU mapping based on your intake. Highlights: 

- I mapped CloudBridge trial SKUs to Redwood public SKUs; see notes column for metering edge cases (per-minute vs per-token).
- Two problematic SKUs: CB-ML-TRIAL-1 (needs explicit quota limits) and CB-ENT-ADV (requires a separate metering tag).
- Suggested temporary fallback: route edge cases to the sandbox SKU to avoid billing re-runs during initial trials.

Open items for the sync: 
- Confirm ACME's acceptance of sandbox routing for the first 500 trial seats.
- Karthik: can you confirm entitlement webhook retries and idempotency?

Attachments: sku-mapping-draft.csv

Ben Carter
Director, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: CloudBridge -> Redwood: marketplace syndication kickoff

All — ran entitlement tests against staging this morning. Results:

- Entitlement-check endpoint accepted CloudBridge test tokens and returned the expected JSON (sku_id, entitlement_status, quota_remaining).
- Observed 2-second p95 under the test load (50 concurrent entitlement checks). This meets our initial SLA but we flagged token-parsing CPU spikes at peak.
- Webhook retry behavior: returns 200 on dedup keys; retry window default is 24 hours — I recommend shortening to 6 hours for trials to simplify reconciliation.

Action items from me: 
- I updated the staging spec and pushed a test harness to the drive link. Please review before the billing cutover.
- Ben: I'll take your draft and annotate the sku edge cases today.

If everyone is good, let's use the Monday call to lock the mapping and sign off on sandbox routing for the initial 500 seats.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
